contentFull:
Wrapping up October 2026: What’s new in the world of pigs?

October brought a wide range of developments across the global pig industry, from advances in piglet health and breeding genetics to new feed innovations and sustainability initiatives. Companies also announced changes to their business structures, expanded into new markets and introduced technologies aimed at improving farm management and production efficiency. Here is a round-up of the latest industry news from October 2026.

Natalie KinsleyFreelance journalist

Nov 4

News

Steri-Solfen reaches approval milestone in 10 European markets

Australian company Medical Ethics has completed the European Decentralised Procedure for Steri-Solfen, a topical anaesthetic and antiseptic solution for piglet castration. The procedure was led by the Netherlands, with 9 other European countries participating. The product combines 2 local anaesthetics with adrenaline and an antiseptic to help manage pain during and after castration.

Agrifirm unites animal nutrition expertise under Nuscience

Royal Agrifirm Group is bringing its specialist animal nutrition businesses together under one global brand, Nuscience. The rollout starts in EMEA, incorporating Agrimprove and Earlyfeed into the portfolio and linking Hamlet Protein's specialist expertise more closely to the broader offering.

Denkavit first to achieve GMP+ Feed LCA certification

Denkavit has become the first company to achieve GMP+ MI5.7 Feed Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) certification, awarded by Kiwa. Building on its existing GMP+ MI5.5 Carbon Footprint of Feed certification, the achievement provides independently verified insight into the environmental impact of its products and processes.

Dr. Eckel highlights AntaSync recognition and leadership transition

Dr. Eckel's AntaSync has been recognised as a novelty for the EuroTier Innovation Award 2026. The company also announced that founders Antje and Bernhard Eckel will step back from day-to-day operations at the end of 2026, with Viktor and Klara Eckel taking over in 2027.

MS Schippers expands HyCare app into Vietnam

MS Schippers has introduced its HyCare app to the Asian market, with the first poultry farms in Vietnam now connected to the digital platform. The system uses sensors, automated water monitoring and digital protocols to help farmers remotely monitor barn hygiene and identify problems early. Its expansion into Vietnam marks the start of further growth in Asia.

Nucléus enters Ukrainian market through genetics partnership

French swine genetics specialist Nucléus has signed a strategic partnership with Ukraine-based Agrifood Consulting to introduce and distribute its PN3 terminal boar genetics in Ukraine. The first boars are expected to be exported from France before the end of 2026, followed by local production to ensure a continuous supply. The PN3 is selected for feed efficiency, growth performance, carcass yield and meat quality.

Hendrix Genetics takes full ownership of swine business

Hendrix Genetics has acquired full ownership of Hendrix Genetics Swine, marking the next step in integrating its Hypor and Danish Genetics breeding activities. The swine business will now operate as a dedicated business unit within the group's global multi-species organisation. Dennis Jørgensen, who took over as Managing Director on 1 September 2026, will lead the integrated operation.

European Protein’s EP199 recognised as EuroTier 2026 innovation

European Protein's EP199, a fermented rapeseed meal and seaweed protein for piglets, has been named a DLG Recognised Novelty ahead of EuroTier 2026. The product can replace soy protein and fish meal in pre- and post-weaning diets. Field trials in Denmark have reported improved daily weight gain, while producers in several European countries are already using it to support piglet gut health and robustness.

DSM-Firmenich names 2 new companies and expands Sustell platform

DSM-Firmenich has named Noviwest and Panavora as the 2 standalone companies that will emerge from the sale of its Animal Nutrition & Health business to CVC Capital Partners. Noviwest will focus on vitamins, carotenoids and aroma ingredients, while Panavora will provide premixes, feed additives and animal nutrition services. Meanwhile, DSM-Firmenich Animal Nutrition & Health has expanded its Sustell environmental footprinting platform, allowing users to incorporate their own farm-level crop production data into sustainability assessments. The new capability aims to improve the accuracy and transparency of environmental footprint calculations across the animal protein value chain and support FLAG and Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi) reporting requirements. For more details on the company split, click here.

Rotem continues under Speria with established product range

Agricultural technology brand Rotem is entering a new phase as part of Speria, while retaining its distinct identity and existing product range. Its climate control and farm management solutions serve pig farms, poultry houses, and greenhouses. Rotem confirms there will be no changes to its products.

Livestock Malaysia 2027 to take place in Kuala Lumpur

The 12th edition of Livestock Malaysia, an international trade show for the feed, livestock and meat industries, will take place from 10-12 August 2027 in Kuala Lumpur. Organised by Informa Markets, the event will showcase innovations in animal feed, livestock production and meat processing, while providing opportunities for industry stakeholders to network.

NUQO holds first international summit in Poland

Feed additive company NUQO held its first international technical and business summit in Poland in October 2026, bringing together teams from 8 countries. Discussions covered product developments, R&D projects, commercial strategies and future growth plans. Delegates also visited the company's Polish production site to see recent investments and expanded capacity.

Vostermans introduces new Multifan Venturon tunnel ventilation fan

Vostermans Ventilation has introduced the Multifan Venturon, a new 57-inch exhaust fan designed for tunnel ventilation in poultry and pig housing. Tested at BESS Labs, the fan combines high airflow, energy efficiency and durability. It is available in different versions, including a Vplus model that offers additional energy savings when used with a variable frequency drive.

Betagro sets target to cut Scope 3 emissions by 25% by 2035

Thai food company Betagro has announced a roadmap to reduce value chain greenhouse gas emissions (Scope 3) by 25% by 2035, as part of its goal to reach net zero by 2050. The company also reported progress in reducing livestock antimicrobial use by 60.8% and operational emissions by 14%, alongside increased use of sustainable packaging.

World Nutrition Forum 2026 brings together over 600 delegates

More than 600 delegates gathered in Kuala Lumpur for DSM-Firmenich Animal Nutrition & Health's World Nutrition Forum 2026. Under the theme 'NextGEN', discussions focused on science, innovation, digital technologies and sustainability in animal production. The event also awarded Ghent University's Professor Gunther Antonissen the NextGEN Award for his contributions to poultry health research.

Novus appoints new executive sales manager in Vietnam

Novus has appointed Huy Tran Cong as executive sales manager for Vietnam to strengthen its commercial presence in the country. Based in Vietnam, he will lead business development and customer relationships across the livestock and aquaculture sectors. He brings experience from Biochem and Alltech, where he held sales and business development roles in Vietnam and Cambodia. He holds a master's degree in animal nutrition and an MBA focused on agricultural business.
translationZh:
**Steri-Solfen在欧洲10个市场达到获批里程碑**

澳大利亚公司Medical Ethics已完成Steri-Solfen的欧洲分散审批程序。Steri-Solfen是一种用于仔猪去势的局部麻醉和抗菌溶液。该程序由荷兰牵头，另有9个欧洲国家参与。该产品将2种局部麻醉剂与肾上腺素和一种抗菌剂结合，帮助管理去势期间和之后的疼痛。

**Agrifirm将动物营养专长统一归入Nuscience品牌**

皇家Agrifirm集团正将其专业动物营养业务整合到一个全球品牌Nuscience之下。推广从EMEA地区开始，将Agrimprove和Earlyfeed纳入产品组合，并将Hamlet Protein的专业能力与更广泛的产品供应更紧密地联系起来。

**Denkavit率先获得GMP+饲料LCA认证**

Denkavit成为首家获得Kiwa颁发的GMP+ MI5.7饲料生命周期评估（LCA）认证的公司。在现有GMP+ MI5.5饲料碳足迹认证的基础上，该成就为其产品和工艺的环境影响提供了独立验证的洞察。

**Dr. Eckel强调AntaSync认可与领导层交接**

Dr. Eckel的AntaSync被认定为EuroTier 2026创新奖的新颖产品。该公司还宣布，创始人Antje和Bernhard Eckel将于2026年底退出日常运营，Viktor和Klara Eckel将于2027年接任。

**MS Schippers将HyCare应用扩展至越南**

MS Schippers已将其HyCare应用引入亚洲市场，越南首批家禽养殖场现已接入该数字平台。该系统利用传感器、自动化水监测和数字协议，帮助养殖户远程监测畜舍卫生并及早发现问题。扩展至越南标志着其在亚洲进一步增长的开始。

**Nucléus通过遗传合作进入乌克兰市场**

法国猪遗传育种专家Nucléus与乌克兰Agrifood Consulting签署战略合作伙伴关系，在乌克兰引进和分销其PN3终端公猪遗传基因。首批公猪预计将于2026年底前从法国出口，随后进行本地生产以确保连续供应。PN3选育目标是饲料效率、生长性能、胴体产量和肉质。

**Hendrix Genetics全资控股猪业务**

Hendrix Genetics已收购Hendrix Genetics Swine的全部所有权，这是整合其Hypor和Danish Genetics育种活动的下一步。该猪业务现将成为集团全球多物种组织内的一个专门业务单元。于2026年9月1日接任董事总经理的Dennis Jørgensen将领导整合后的运营。

**European Protein的EP199获EuroTier 2026创新认可**

European Protein的EP199是一种用于仔猪的发酵菜籽粕和海藻蛋白，在EuroTier 2026之前被命名为DLG认可的新颖产品。该产品可在断奶前和断奶后日粮中替代大豆蛋白和鱼粉。丹麦的田间试验报告日增重改善，多个欧洲国家的生产商已在使用它来支持仔猪肠道健康和稳健性。

**DSM-Firmenich命名2家新公司并扩展Sustell平台**

DSM-Firmenich已将其动物营养与健康业务出售给CVC Capital Partners后产生的2家独立公司命名为Noviwest和Panavora。Noviwest将专注于维生素、类胡萝卜素和香气成分，而Panavora将提供预混料、饲料添加剂和动物营养服务。与此同时，DSM-Firmenich动物营养与健康已扩展其Sustell环境足迹平台，允许用户将自有农场级作物生产数据纳入可持续性评估。新功能旨在提高动物蛋白价值链环境足迹计算的准确性和透明度，并支持FLAG和科学碳目标倡议（SBTi）报告要求。有关公司拆分的更多详情，请点击此处。

**Rotem在Speria旗下继续运营并保留现有产品系列**

农业技术品牌Rotem作为Speria的一部分进入新阶段，同时保留其独特身份和现有产品系列。其气候控制和农场管理解决方案服务于猪场、禽舍和温室。Rotem确认其产品不会有任何变化。

**Livestock Malaysia 2027将在吉隆坡举行**

第12届Livestock Malaysia——饲料、畜牧和肉类行业国际贸易展——将于2027年8月10日至12日在吉隆坡举行。该活动由Informa Markets主办，将展示动物饲料、畜牧生产和肉类加工的创新，同时为行业利益相关者提供交流机会。

**NUQO在波兰举行首届国际峰会**

饲料添加剂公司NUQO于2026年10月在波兰举行了首届国际技术和商业峰会，汇集了来自8个国家的团队。讨论涵盖产品开发、研发项目、商业策略和未来增长计划。代表们还参观了公司的波兰生产基地，了解近期投资和扩大的产能。

**Vostermans推出新款Multifan Venturon隧道通风风机**

Vostermans Ventilation推出了Multifan Venturon，这是一款新型57英寸排风机，专为家禽和猪舍的隧道通风设计。该风机在BESS Labs进行了测试，结合了高气流、能效和耐用性。它有不同的版本可供选择，包括Vplus型号，与变频驱动器配合使用时提供额外的节能效果。

**Betagro设定到2035年范围三排放减少25%的目标**

泰国食品公司Betagro宣布了到2035年将价值链温室气体排放（范围三）减少25%的路线图，作为其到2050年实现净零目标的一部分。该公司还报告了在减少牲畜抗菌药物使用方面取得的进展（减少60.8%）和运营排放减少14%，同时增加了可持续包装的使用。

**2026年世界营养论坛汇集600多名代表**

600多名代表齐聚吉隆坡参加DSM-Firmenich动物营养与健康的世界营养论坛2026。在“NextGEN”主题下，讨论聚焦于动物生产中的科学、创新、数字技术和可持续性。该活动还授予根特大学Gunther Antonissen教授NextGEN奖，以表彰其对家禽健康研究的贡献。

**Novus在越南任命新的执行销售经理**

Novus已任命Huy Tran Cong为越南执行销售经理，以加强其在该国的商业存在。他常驻越南，将领导畜牧和水产养殖领域的业务发展和客户关系。他带来了在Biochem和Alltech的经验，曾在越南和柬埔寨担任销售和业务发展职务。他拥有动物营养硕士学位和专注于农业商业的MBA学位。
author: Natalie Kinsley
